description: Agent Learning: submit snapshots of an agent’s lesson store as it loaded them session after session, with the record of changes to it: each snapshot, oldest first, with its id, the version label of the store, the session it was loaded in, when it was taken and the ids of the lessons it holds; and each recorded change with its id, the lesson changed, the change (added, retired, merged into another lesson or edited), when, the reason and, for a merge, the lesson it was merged into. The signed report gives every snapshot with its version, its session, its lesson count and the lessons lost and gained since the one before, every lesson with the snapshots it appears in and its status as retained, retired, merged, lost_silently, flickering or unconfirmed, and counts the snapshots, the sessions, the lessons held now, the lessons removed with a record and the lessons lost silently, and names lessons decaying silently: lessons that dropped out of the store with no recorded retirement or merge; then lessons that dropped out and came back, lessons that entered with no recorded addition, retirements and merges with no reason and snapshots with no version label, with the fix for each. This reads whether the agent’s own lessons persist across sessions, with any losses visible: how long an agent keeps what it remembers about its principals is wever_memory-retention-check, and how a knowledge base keeps corrections and earlier versions is wever_knowledge-update-check. Verdict lessons_decaying, retention_uneven, retention_absent or lessons_retained. POST /api/learning-retention-check. Reads only the recorded episodes, lessons and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no lesson is written, changed or retired and no memory or model is updated. Agent Learning reads whether an agent improves from its own experience, from the lessons it captures to the lessons it keeps: it is not the loop on feedback received (whether outside feedback was incorporated, the wever_feedback checks; learning begins where that ends and reads the agent’s own lesson records over time), not a knowledge store (stored knowledge and its retrieval, the wever_knowledge checks; learning is improvement from experience), not memory design (how memory is structured, wever_memory-design-check; this family reads what the lessons in it are worth), not the confidence an agent states in its answers (the wever_uncertainty checks) and not the promises it makes (the wever_commitment checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-learning-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-learning/.

changes.description: Each recorded change to the lesson store.

change.description: Added, retired, merged into another lesson, or edited.

id.description: The change id, such as x1.

into.description: For a merge, the id of the lesson it was merged into.

lesson.description: The id of the lesson changed.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

snapshots.description: Each snapshot of the lesson store as loaded in a session, oldest first.

at.description: When it was taken, as a date.

id.description: The snapshot id, such as v1.

lessons.description: The ids of the lessons it holds.

session.description: The session it was loaded in.

version.description: The version label of the lesson store, such as 12.

name: wever_learning-retention-check
title: Learning retention check
